candidate.title: Teaching AI Reasoning: Chain of Thought Prompting #ai #llm #artificialintelligence
candidate.description:
In the world of Artificial Intelligence, a game-changing technique is emerging, known as Chain-of-Thought Prompting. This approach is fundamentally altering the way language models like ChatGPT reason and think, making them more human-like in their problem-solving abilities.

What is Chain-of-Thought Prompting?

Simply put, it involves instructing a language model by providing a few-shot exemplar, which is an example problem and solution, along with the steps the model took to arrive at the solution. For instance, when teaching a model to solve math problems, you'd start with an example problem and its step-by-step solution.

It ensures that language models think methodically and logically, mimicking the human reasoning process. Instead of jumping to conclusions, the model dissects the problem step-by-step, explaining its reasoning along the way.
